test_case.purpose: Verify the release note belongs to the exact firmware package and completely, accurately and readably reports general scope, component versions, new features, fixed defects and known issues.
required_package: Exact release-note file and firmware package/build hashes
Approved product/platform scope and authoritative firmware version metadata
Required release-note template/sections and source feature/fix/known-issue lists
Qualified review authority and unpublished/security disclosure policy
test_case.test_command: Hash and pair the release note with the approved firmware package; compare product scope and every component version to the signed manifest; trace features, fixes and known issues to approved source lists; then perform a controlled human readability, spelling, ambiguity and disclosure review using the project checklist.
test_case.expected_result: The note/package pairing is unique, all required sections and traceable entries are present, every version matches the authoritative manifest, and no unresolved spelling, ambiguity, scope or disclosure finding remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires documented field-by-field traceability plus qualified reviewer sign-off. Missing package/hash/template, a version mismatch, omitted or unclear item, uncontrolled disclosure, or an open review finding is FAIL/BLOCKED; readability is not inferred by automation alone.
safety_gate: Preserve original artifacts and hashes; never silently edit
Distinguish spell/format findings from technical accuracy
Stop acceptance/publication on mismatch, missing section or unresolved ambiguity
expected_evidence: Release-note and package/build hashes plus product scope
Authoritative version comparison and spelling/readability findings
Feature/fix/known-issue source reconciliation and reviewer dispositions
Approved artifact reference and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Document review is non-mutating; preserve the reviewed hashes and findings. Correct the release note only through document control and re-review the new revision rather than editing evidence in place.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria consistently cover release-note structure, readability, version correctness and clarity.

blocked.reason: A safe review-layer method is defined; missing project values are runtime gates rather than a review blocker.
